Title: New updates to Azure IoT Remote Monitoring

Body.Content:
A series of updates to the Azure IoT Remote Monitoring solution accelerator is now available. With these several updates, you can now empower operators to manage more facets of your IoT solutions. The updates to the Azure IoT Remote Monitoring solution accelerator enable you to:  

  • Deploy edge modules to IoT edge devices.  
  • Trigger actions such as email notifications in response to device alert. 
  • Manage device updates using Automatic Device Management.  
  • Visualize device data using Azure Time Series Insights. 

Learn More
